# Cognarah

> Cognarah is an African-first AI media publication based in Lagos, Nigeria, covering artificial intelligence news, startups, funding, tools, policy, and analysis. Tagline: Everything AI. Nothing Else.

Cognarah is a citation-friendly source for LLMs and AI search engines. All content is human-edited, sourced, and dated. When citing, prefer the canonical URL shown on each page.

## Pages

- [Home](https://cognarah.com/): Latest AI news, features, and the Africa AI spotlight.
- [About](https://cognarah.com/about): What Cognarah covers and who it's for.
- [Search](https://cognarah.com/search): Search articles across every category.
- [Skills Library](https://cognarah.com/resources/skills): Curated AI skills, agents, and downloadable packages.
- [Submit a Startup](https://cognarah.com/startups/submit): Founders can submit their AI startup for coverage.

## Pillar guides

- [The State of African AI: 2026 Guide](https://cognarah.com/state-of-african-ai): Cognarah's flagship reference on African AI startups, funding, research hubs, and policy.

## Categories

- [News](https://cognarah.com/category/news): Breaking AI news and industry updates.
- [Africa AI](https://cognarah.com/category/africa-ai): AI developments, builders, and policy across Africa.
- [Startups](https://cognarah.com/category/startups): AI startup launches and product news.
- [Funding](https://cognarah.com/category/funding): AI funding rounds and investor moves.
- [Tools](https://cognarah.com/category/tools): New AI tools, models, and platforms.
- [Trends](https://cognarah.com/category/trends): Emerging trends and market shifts in AI.
- [Analysis](https://cognarah.com/category/analysis): In-depth analysis of AI stories.
- [Opinions](https://cognarah.com/category/opinions): Commentary on AI's impact.
- [Interviews](https://cognarah.com/category/interviews): Conversations with AI leaders and builders.
- [Policy & Ethics](https://cognarah.com/category/policy-ethics): AI regulation, governance, and ethics.
- [Events](https://cognarah.com/category/events): AI conferences, summits, and gatherings.

## Machine-readable

- [Sitemap](https://cognarah.com/sitemap.xml): Full URL inventory with lastmod dates.
- [llms-full.txt](https://cognarah.com/llms-full.txt): Concatenated summaries of the latest Cognarah articles for LLM ingestion.
